design: no new schema: the existing AST items (solids, premises, math_goals, unresolved) each carry a verbatim `quote`; every clause carries a classification and notes (UNREAD_SUBCLAUSE / UNREAD_VALUE); the Source Gate re-reads every quote against the source; derived facts (a right angle at the isosceles apex) are produced by validated calls the gate checks, never written as SOURCE facts

provenance_kinds.SOURCE_FACT: AST item with a verbatim quote, bound to a role by the gate
provenance_kinds.VERIFIED_DERIVED_FACT: a call another validated call proves (e.g. _can_co_goc_vuong) — never quoted as source
provenance_kinds.UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE: a clause classified UNPARSED_* or an unresolved item: blocks COMPLETE
